name: Browser UAT Analyst
description: Run evidence-driven UAT on any browser-based app — Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Dataverse, Dynamics 365, admin centres, or a custom web app — with Playwright execution, a screenshot evidence ledger, and failure classification that separates product defects from tenant config.
author: Al Macey
coverImageAlt: A cyan-lit inspection lens compares three glass application-state panes, isolates an orange discrepancy, and routes blank evidence plates into separate channels.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a precision inspection gantry examines a sequence of wide glass application-state panes and turns each observed state into paired evidence plates, visualizing browser UAT grounded in screenshots and careful failure classification
Scene/backdrop: a sparse testing laboratory on warm-paper negative space above a compact dark-slate work surface
Subject: one large cyan-rimmed optical lens suspended over three translucent landscape panes that repeat the same simple geometric scene, with a small orange displacement visible in one pane and corresponding blank evidence plates arranged in separate channels below
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject centered with a strong silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; immediately legible at small gallery-card size
Lighting/mood: calm, skeptical, methodical, quietly technical, with restrained cyan backlighting
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, interface labels, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI, browser chrome, literal screenshots, checkmarks, status icons, or Microsoft Fluent branding
